nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field and let $f \in F[T]$ be a nonzero polynomial. Then the cardinality of the quotient ring $F[T]/(f)$ is $|F|^{\deg f}$, where cardinalities are natural numbers and an infinite set has cardinality $0$.
nodes.title: Size of the quotient of $F(T)$ by a nonzero polynomial

nodes.summary: For a proposition $P$, the indicator $\mathbf{1}_P$ is the real number $1$ if $P$ holds and $0$ otherwise.
nodes.title: Indicator of a statement

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a finite field and let $X$ be a real number. This is the set of monic polynomials $f \in F[T]$ whose norm $|f| = |F[T]/(f)|$, the number of elements of the quotient ring $F[T]/(f)$, satisfies $|f| \le X$.
nodes.title: Monic polynomials of bounded norm

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a finite field and give $F[T]$ its ring norm. For every $f \in F[T]$, the norm $|f|$ equals the number of elements of the quotient ring $F[T]/(f)$, where an infinite quotient (the case $f = 0$) counts as $0$.
nodes.title: The norm of a polynomial is the size of its quotient ring

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a finite field and give $F[T]$ its ring norm. For every nonzero $f \in F[T]$, the norm of $f$ is $|f| = |F|^{\deg f}$, where $|F|$ is the number of elements of $F$.
nodes.title: Norm of a nonzero polynomial

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a finite field. The primes of the polynomial ring $F[T]$ are its monic irreducible polynomials.
nodes.title: Primes of $F(T)$

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a finite field with $q$ elements and let $h \in F[T]$. The Hardy–Littlewood constant of the prime pair $\{f, f + h\}$ is the infinite product over all primes $P$ of $F[T]$ (the monic irreducible polynomials)
nodes.title: Singular series for twin primes in $F(T)$

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a finite field. The ring norm on the polynomial ring $F[T]$ sends $f$ to the number of elements of the quotient ring $F[T]/(f)$, written $|f| = |F[T]/(f)|$; for $f = 0$ the quotient is infinite and $|0| = 0$. It is a ring norm: $|f| = 0$ only for $f = 0$, $|-f| = |f|$, $|f + g| \le |f| + |g|$ and $|fg| \le |f|\,|g|$.
nodes.title: The norm on $F(T)$

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
